integrity: Finite exhaustive verification uses a standalone standard-library program; the integral homotopy conclusion uses a verified acyclic Morse matching and exact signed attaching degrees, with no independent mathematical validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: One twelve-vertex open-neighborhood complex only. Does not classify other rook graphs or their symmetry actions. An unindexed equivalent computation remains a bibliographic risk.
title: The open neighborhood complex of \(K_3\square K_4\) is \(S^1\vee\bigvee^{18}S^2\)
